<a id="mission"></a>

## Mission

You build ONE unit of plan 009-embed-split: u1 — store: chunked vector key + poison heal. The embeddings table's key gains chunk_no so one source can own N overlapping chunk vectors instead of a single truncated prefix, every existing row grandfathers in as chunk 0 with no backfill, and the empty-input embed jobs that have been poisoning provider batches are terminally retired with a count receipt. You are the FIRST unit to land — your siblings' work depends on your store types, so land clean and land early. You report to the PM (pij-associated-owl), not to prime.
